$comment: Merge routing (FEATURES.md H7, H8). Lives at .factory/merge-policy.json. merge-route.sh puts every PR in one band - trivial, standard, careful or blocked - and posts a label plus a review brief so each human review is short and goes to the right person. Humans merge (H4). The only exception is H8: in mode 'auto', trivial-band PRs get the host's native auto-merge, which still obeys branch protection. The factory never approves its own PR and never bypasses protection.
$mode: off = do nothing (the kill switch). advise = label, brief and record only. auto = advise, plus native auto-merge for the trivial band; allowed only once 'promotion' is met.

evidence.$comment: Everything is computed by merge-route.sh from git and the CI provider at the PR's head commit. The only agent-supplied input is the review-result events recorded for that commit, or for an ancestor followed only by documentation changes (verdict and open findings), and those can only make a band stricter. A renamed file is checked under both paths. Missing, pending or unreadable evidence routes to careful. If the head commit changes, the band is recomputed before anything happens.
evidence.ci: required checks on <head> from the provider (gh pr checks)
evidence.factory: feature metadata, plus review-result events whose revision is <head>

careful_if.$comment: Any match: review by a code owner (reviewer tier 'owner'). Globs are anchored at the repository root (use **/ for any depth) and matched against every changed path, both sides of a rename. .factory/*.json covers config, this policy, intent, plan and licenses; feature notes and reviews under .factory/ are Markdown and count as docs.

trivial_if.$comment: ALL must hold, and nothing above matched. Categories are deliberately mechanical: every changed path must fall in an enabled category, so no judgment (human or AI) is needed to put a PR here.

tests_additive.$comment: New test files, or lines added to existing ones with none removed or changed: cannot weaken an existing assertion.

copy.$comment: Translation and UI string files. Off by default: wording can carry legal or pricing meaning.

standard.$comment: Everything else: one review by any engineer (reviewer tier 'any'), guided by the brief.

reviewer_tiers.$comment: Who a band is routed to. 'owner' uses CODEOWNERS when present. Map to GitHub teams or people.

external_scorers.$comment: Optional AI scores (e.g. Jev from the MCP catalog), passed to merge-route.sh with --scores. They can only move a PR to a stricter band, never to a more lenient one; missing scores change nothing.

review_brief.$comment: Posted as one PR comment and refreshed on every push. The point is to make review fast, not to replace it.
sections: band and every rule that placed it there
what changed, per feature, with requirement IDs
where to look: the few files and lines carrying the risk
evidence at the head commit: CI checks, tests added, reviewer verdicts, open findings, licenses
what the factory did not check

promotion.$comment: mode 'auto' is refused until 'merge-route.sh report' shows all of these over PRs routed in advise mode. A trivial-band PR counts as agreed when a human approved it without requesting changes.
